conditions: Objective-C compiled with ARC enabled under the Clang 19.1.0 specification. The operation is on supported storage holding a retainable Objective-C object pointer within its lifetime.
The type and target support weak references, the storage holds a live pointee, and the full expression does not exit through an exception.
limitations: This is a semantic requirement for the scoped read. It excludes absent or deallocating pointees, unsupported weak types, exceptional cleanup, non-ARC mode, and any optimization claim about emitted calls.

triggers: Applicable guide or ARC correction, archive or release byte drift, material contrary evidence, or change in the language identity boundary.

statement: Under the Clang 19.1.0 ARC rules, an lvalue-to-rvalue read of weak-qualified Objective-C object-pointer storage with a live pointee retains that pointee through the full expression and releases it when the full expression completes normally.
